citation_rule: file + function only; never line numbers

citations.role: Driver: builds layers, calls slice_volumes, applies XY compensation, layer->make_slices. Does not walk the mesh itself.
citations.pnp_contrast: PrePass::Slice uses one batched slice_mesh_ex per object (batch_slice_objects_by_layer) and then classifies unsupported bottom areas per layer.

citations.role: One triangle pass over all Z planes (each triangle binary-searches its span), loop chaining parallel over layers, polygon assembly parallel over layers.
citations.pnp_contrast: Same one-walk shape in PnP's slice_mesh_ex; the wall difference is implementation, not work set.

citations.role: Per layer: top diff + opening, bottom diff + opening, internal diff; crack block only when top and bottom overlap; optional interface shells and top-surface expansion are off for this job.
citations.pnp_contrast: Pass 1 of PrePass::ShellClassification ports this with the same two diffs + openings.

citations.role: The active vertical-shell pass at ensure_vertical_shell_thickness = evstAll: per-layer parallel cache of top/bottom/hole unions, then shell accumulation.
citations.pnp_contrast: No PnP equivalent; PnP ports discover_horizontal_shells instead.

citations.role: Serial shrinking-shadow cascade. Early-outs per region when ensure_vertical_shell_thickness == evstAll, which is the canonical default.
citations.pnp_contrast: Pass 2 of PrePass::ShellClassification ports this cascade; at matched settings canonical does not run it.

citations.role: Gathers internal-solid candidates; per layer ~7 Clipper ops; per candidate ~15 boolean/offset ops plus construct_anchored_polygon; bbox-clips every downstream intersection via clip_clipper_polygons_with_subject_bbox and caches boundary_by_spacing.
citations.pnp_contrast: gate_internal_bridge_sites does the same qualification with two whole-layer offsets (deep_infill_area +1.5*spacing and -4.5*spacing) and per-surface offsets, but no bbox-clipped downstream intersections.

citations.role: Builds three ExpansionZones from union_ex; expands bridges/bottoms/tops with RegionExpansion wave propagation; trims zones; culls small internal regions. Parallel over regions then layers.
citations.pnp_contrast: Not ported (DEV-200). PnP's PrePass::Slice classifies the unsupported bottom set but does not expand bridges into the shell/sparse/top zones or trim them.

citations.role: Per wave set: seed offset + initial offset + (nsteps-1) step offsets + (1+nsteps) clips, all clipped to the subject bbox (clip_clipper_polygons_with_subject_bbox); nsteps <= 5, expansion_step 0.1 mm.
citations.pnp_contrast: No counterpart; this is canonical's largest per-layer Clipper-op consumer in the pre-G-code phase.

citations.role: Slice phase, parallel over layers: diff_ex(current lslices, offset_ex(lower lslices, +0.3*line_width)) then offset2_ex(-0.1*line_width, +0.1*line_width). One binary loverhangs set per layer; consumed only by GCode::needs_retraction.
citations.pnp_contrast: PrePass::OverhangAnnotation computes 3 offsets per band layer + ~9.8 clips, producing 4 quartile band polygons for wall/infill annotation; 85.4% of the stage is the 3 offsets (t84).

citations.role: G-code emission, parallel over layers: builds a LinesDistancer<Linef3> from lower->lslices, queries one signed distance per perimeter/bridge vertex, maps overlap to speed by linear interpolation over {90,75,50,25,13,0}%.
citations.pnp_contrast: Canonical has no 4-band polygon partition, no 3 whole-layer offsets, and no per-layer band clips; band membership is a numeric distance comparison.

citations.role: G-code export: candidates are the printed external-perimeter loop points; per-vertex overhang/embedding distances via LinesDistancer; per-layer parallel candidate/visibility/pick; sequential whole-object B-spline alignment; place_seam per loop at emission.
citations.pnp_contrast: seam-planner-default computes a per-region offset(-0.5*line_width) inset and projects the chosen seam onto it; SeamPlacer.cpp contains no offset call. The inset is a PnP device with no canonical counterpart.

citations.role: Canonical overhang geometry is per layer, from slices: one diff + offsets (supports-off) or diff + cantilever/sharp-tail probes (supports-on). There is no whole-mesh facet classification or whole-mesh overhang footprint union.
citations.pnp_contrast: PrePass::MeshAnalysis classifies 2.46M facet normals, builds a half-edge adjacency map, clusters bridge facets, and unions 326,546 projected overhang triangles into an xy_footprint; t76 partitioned the union to 4.26 s on base-off.

citations.function: TreeSupport::generate / detect_overhangs / generate_contact_points / drop_nodes / smooth_nodes / draw_circles / generate_toolpaths
citations.role: The executed tree_strong path (organic returns early to TreeSupport3D). Per-node drop/collision/avoidance with a radius/layer-keyed cache; per-layer draw/clip/trim; contact points from corners, branch-distance walks and a grid.
citations.pnp_contrast: tree-support-planner is a port of the same legacy path, so the algorithmic work set is comparable. PnP's occupancy inflation is uncached at the per-layer and per-origin sites (t113), while canonical's calculate_collision/calculate_avoidance are cached by {radius, layer, recursions}.

citations.role: collision = offset_ex(layer outline, radius + support_object_xy_distance) + expolygons_simplify; avoidance = recursive offset_ex(-max_move_distance) + insert(collision) + union_ex, cached in tbb::concurrent_unordered_map keyed by radius and layer.
citations.pnp_contrast: PnP has a TreeVolumes ladder but prefers the exact per-layer occupancy and inflates it with an uncached host::offset_polygons at two sites; t113 measured 32.7 s / 864 calls on base-on.
